content:
Maya: Heads-up: quick review of invite modal for org settings. Main asks: 1) surface role recommendations (org + domain aware), 2) clearer wording for the "Keep access until revoked" option, 3) relocate SSO control into a compact chip to reduce row width, 4) micro-link to open audit log filtered to the invite event. Need accessibility and small-viewport constraints considered.

Ravi: Can you sketch the compact chip idea?

Maya: Tiny mock (text only):

Maya: ```
Invite member to Acme Org
[email input]  [Role ▾]  [Suggested: Read, Analyst]  [Keep access until revoked (i)]  [SSO •]  [Send]

Role list:
- Read (view only)
- Analyst (view + query)
- Owner (manage org)
```

Lena: Wording: I prefer the verb-first label — "Keep access until revoked" — and the helper copy should be one short sentence. e.g. "Remains assigned until an admin removes it."

Connor: Accessibility items:
- The helper (i) must be focusable and have `aria-describedby` linking to the short help text.
- Role suggestions should fire a polite live-region announcement when shown ("Suggested roles: Read, Analyst").
- SSO chip needs an `aria-pressed` or state announcement when it blocks persistent grants.

Ravi: SSO chip behavior idea: show three states
- Enforced: red chip text "SSO enforced" and disable persistent toggle
- Optional: neutral chip "SSO available" that opens a small panel
- Not configured: subtle "SSO not set up" with quick link to settings

Maya: Good. UX constraint: modal max height 640px. If helper text pushes layout, show a truncated line with a hover card for longer explanations. No multi-line helpers in the main row.

Lena: Analytics we should emit: `invite.role_selected`, `invite.persistent_set`, `invite.sso_panel_opened`, `invite.audit_jump`. Also track whether the helper was keyboard-visited `invite.helper_opened`.

Connor: For audit-jump link, implement as a tiny anchor under the invite summary: "Open audit for invite". Link example: 
```
/audit?filter=invite&user=jordan%40example.com
```
Make sure backend accepts those query params and the UI shows the filter pill.

Maya: Accessibility for that link: announce context: use link text "Open audit for invite to jordan@example.com" (or programmatically set `aria-label`). Ensure the audit page H1 includes the active filter.

Ravi: Density question for roles matrix: default to 'comfortable' unless org has 'dense' setting toggled. Add an org-level switch labeled "Compact rows" under Org preferences.

Lena: In invite modal we should not force density changes; stick with comfortable and use smaller type for compact variant only in the matrix view.

Connor: Keyboard flow I'd like recorded for devs:
1) Focus email -> type -> Tab -> Role dropdown opens with Enter -> Arrow keys to pick -> Enter selects -> Tab -> helper (i) -> Enter to open -> Esc closes -> Tab -> persistent toggle -> Space toggles -> Tab -> SSO chip -> Enter opens panel -> Tab to Send -> Enter sends.

Maya: Nice. Also require visible focus ring on chip and helper icon per accessibility audit.

UXBot: Heuristic: suggest top-3 role picks based on (a) last 5 roles used by inviter, (b) domain mapping, (c) org-default mappings. Show a subtle badge like "Suggested" and allow one-tap accept. :sparkles:

Lena: One more copy note: change micro-link copy from "Open audit for invite" -> "View invite audit" to be shorter and consistent with other audit links. Screen reader label must remain full-context.

Ravi: No engineering blockers. We'll want the audit link contract spec in a short doc and the analytics event names.

Maya: Next steps: I'll update the Figma with two layouts (chip vs inline SSO row), add helper text variants, and drop a tiny spec for aria attributes + keyboard order. Please review by EOD tomorrow so we can roll a 10% canary.

Connor: +1. I'll add the keyboard test cases to the E2E checklist.

Lena: +1 on copy and a11y checks. Thanks!
